title: Bump opum-lore federated pin to v0.9.2
description: Re-resolve and pin the opum-lore federated entry to the newly published v0.9.2 tag (relayed by lore-cli, LCLI-469 handshake), and regenerate this repo's lore agent bridges to match.

acceptanceCriteria.text: marketplace.json opum-lore ref bumped to v0.9.2, independently re-resolved (tag->commit->tree->skills subtree) rather than trusted from the relay
scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json opum-lore entry updated with the new skills subtree SHA and a note recording the independent verification chain and content summary
lore check passes locally under lore@0.9.2 installed fresh (not the older globally-installed version)
lore agents --check passes after regenerating CLAUDE.md managed block and .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md under lore@0.9.2
PR opened, required checks green, landed

finalSummary: Bumped opum-lore federated pin v0.9.1 -> v0.9.2 (lore-cli LCLI-469 handshake). Unlike the last two bumps this is a real content change (LCLI-573, opum-ai/lore-cli#237), not bookkeeping: skills/lore/SKILL.md was rewritten -- confirmed by fetching and diffing both v0.9.1 and v0.9.2 blobs directly rather than trusting the relay's description. Tag chain independently re-resolved via the GitHub API and cross-checked via git ls-remote --tags as a second source: v0.9.2 -> tag object ed4153bee35db7c0ee3b910a97d79d9f0ce7f12e -> commit 71f2c1e470aac36465871652ddf5347d5b0382c0 -> root tree 338c9c93afd340c70f8d0d929c4ee161dfbb27f0 -> skills subtree ce580cd17d1da6a61ddb53f649398719b9262f96, matching lore-cli's relayed SHAs exactly. plugin.json at the tag self-declares 0.9.2; npm dist-tags.latest confirmed 0.9.2 on the main package and all 6 platform packages. Ran lore check under 0.9.2 (via npx --yes @opum-ai/lore@0.9.2, not the older globally-installed 0.9.0) against this repo's docs/ bundle: 0 errors. lore agents --check under 0.9.2 correctly flagged this repo's CLAUDE.md managed block and .claude/skills/lore/SKILL.md as stale against the new generator output; regenerated both via lore agents --force in the same change, re-confirmed lore agents --check exits 0 afterward. scripts/check-federated-pins.mjs and scripts/check-federated-content.mjs both pass locally against the bumped pin and baseline. PR opum-ai/opum-marketplace#144 green on all three required checks (lore check, check . manifests, Tracker integrity), CI run 36008517115.
